scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: Talk to the Yggdrasil Gatekeeper at (nyd_dun02 99, 199). How to reach the gatekeeper: Enter Yggdrasil Dungeon at (spl_fld01 368, 112). Enter the portal located at 3 o'clock of the map (nyd_dun01 252, 144) (not shown on minimap). The portal markings on the minimap are exits only. Once in level 2, walk right until you've reached a cliff. Control the "Strange Device" at (nyd_dun02 137, 274), and cross the canyon by stepping on the circles. Stepping anywhere outside the shown circles will return you to the bottom right corner of the previous map. After crossing the cliff, follow the path consisting of stairs and roots until you've arrived at a gate at (nyd_dun02 99, 199).
1.short_ru: Пройдите через портал nyd_dun01 252, 144 и Strange Device (nyd_dun02 137, 274) к Yggdrasil Gatekeeper (nyd_dun02 99, 199).
1.short_en: Use the portal at nyd_dun01 252, 144 and Strange Device (nyd_dun02 137, 274) to reach Yggdrasil Gatekeeper (nyd_dun02 99, 199).
1.full_ru: Поговорите с Yggdrasil Gatekeeper (nyd_dun02 99, 199). Путь: войдите в Yggdrasil Dungeon через spl_fld01 368, 112. Войдите в портал на 3 часа (nyd_dun01 252, 144), не отмеченный на миникарте; видимые метки порталов обозначают только выходы. На уровне 2 двигайтесь вправо до обрыва. Используйте Strange Device (nyd_dun02 137, 274) и переходите каньон, наступая на круги. Шаг вне кругов вернёт в нижний правый угол предыдущей карты. После обрыва идите по лестницам и корням к воротам (nyd_dun02 99, 199).
1.full_en: Talk to the Yggdrasil Gatekeeper at (nyd_dun02 99, 199). How to reach the gatekeeper: Enter Yggdrasil Dungeon at (spl_fld01 368, 112). Enter the portal located at 3 o'clock of the map (nyd_dun01 252, 144) (not shown on minimap). The portal markings on the minimap are exits only. Once in level 2, walk right until you've reached a cliff. Control the "Strange Device" at (nyd_dun02 137, 274), and cross the canyon by stepping on the circles. Stepping anywhere outside the shown circles will return you to the bottom right corner of the previous map. After crossing the cliff, follow the path consisting of stairs and roots until you've arrived at a gate at (nyd_dun02 99, 199).

locations.condition: Literal source spelling; conflicts with spl_fild01 in Two Tribes and is not reference-known.

actions.condition: Step only on the circles; stepping off returns to the previous map.

2.original_instruction: Tell Commander Agip (mid_campin 90, 121) about the cave you found, he tells you to find Historian Magnifier.
2.short_ru: Расскажите Commander Agip о пещере: mid_campin 90, 121.
2.short_en: Tell Commander Agip about the cave: mid_campin 90, 121.
2.full_ru: Сообщите Commander Agip (mid_campin 90, 121) о найденной пещере. Он направит к Historian Magnifier.
2.full_en: Tell Commander Agip (mid_campin 90, 121) about the cave you found, he tells you to find Historian Magnifier.

3.original_instruction: Ask Historian Magnifier (mid_camp 271, 299) for help. He tells you to visit his assistant in the Prontera library.
3.full_ru: Попросите помощи у Historian Magnifier (mid_camp 271, 299). Он направит к помощнице в библиотеке Prontera.
3.full_en: Ask Historian Magnifier (mid_camp 271, 299) for help. He tells you to visit his assistant in the Prontera library.

4.original_instruction: In the west Prontera Library (prontera 120, 264), talk to Assistant Naomi (prt_in 171, 94), and she will give you several papers to read.
4.full_ru: Войдите в западную Prontera Library (prontera 120, 264). Поговорите с Assistant Naomi (prt_in 171, 94), она даст несколько документов для чтения.
4.full_en: In the west Prontera Library (prontera 120, 264), talk to Assistant Naomi (prt_in 171, 94), and she will give you several papers to read.

actions.condition: Source narrative; inventory item names and count are unknown.

5.original_instruction: Return to Magnifier, he tells you to go investigate what the Laphine and Sapha know. Chose to go to either the Laphine or Sapha. Laphine: Talk to the Grumbling Soldier in the Splendide (splendide 198, 178), and ask him about the tree. Inside the central building (splendide 197, 191), speak to the Laphine Commander (spl_in01 110, 60). Sapha: Inside the building in the far right of Manuk (309, 142), talk to the Laphine Prisoner (man_in01 291, 62). Talk to Neat Etorr (man_in01 311, 57) in the same building.
5.short_ru: У Magnifier выберите, кого расспросить: Laphine или Sapha.
5.short_en: At Magnifier, choose whom to question: Laphine or Sapha.
5.full_ru: Вернитесь к Magnifier. Он предложит узнать, что знают Laphine и Sapha. Выберите, к кому обратиться: Laphine или Sapha.
5.full_en: Return to Magnifier, he tells you to go investigate what the Laphine and Sapha know. Chose to go to either the Laphine or Sapha.

6.original_instruction: Return to Magnifier, he tells you to speak to Commander Agip to get his opinion.

7.original_instruction: Commander Agip decides to ask both tribes for help exploring the cave. This will force each to help you to prevent you from getting help from their enemy.
7.short_ru: Обсудите с Commander Agip помощь обеих сторон.
7.short_en: Discuss assistance from both tribes with Commander Agip.
7.full_ru: Commander Agip решит попросить обе стороны помочь с исследованием пещеры: каждая согласится, чтобы не дать преимущество врагу.
7.full_en: Commander Agip decides to ask both tribes for help exploring the cave. This will force each to help you to prevent you from getting help from their enemy.

8.original_instruction: You are presented with a choice of which tribe to go to in order to seek assistance. Laphine Branch: Speak to the Laphine Commander, and threaten to ask the Sapha's help if she refuses hers. She will agree to help and ask you to talk to Aide Arioss. Aide Arioss (spl_in01 104, 56) will give you a token to mark you as a guardian of the yggdrasil and tell you the password to get past the door. Sapha Branch: Return to the building in Manuk and talk to Neat Etorr again. Talk to the Laphine Prisoner twice.
8.short_ru: Выберите Laphine или Sapha для получения помощи.
8.short_en: Choose Laphine or Sapha for assistance.
8.full_ru: Выберите, к какому племени обратиться за помощью.
8.full_en: You are presented with a choice of which tribe to go to in order to seek assistance.

9.original_instruction: At this step you can now enter the Nidhoggur's Nest Instance. After you clear the instance, talk to Yggdrasiliad in the final room. Note: The instance is very difficult and will require a strong party to complete. Note 2: This quest can not currently be completed on iRO , the Yggdrasilid in the instance does not appear to set a needed quest variable.

9.short_en: Clear Nidhoggur's Nest Instance and talk to Yggdrasiliad; heed the source’s iRO warning.
9.full_ru: Теперь можно войти в Nidhoggur's Nest Instance. После прохождения поговорите с Yggdrasiliad в последней комнате. Примечание: подземелье очень сложно, нужна сильная группа. Примечание 2: источник сообщает, что квест нельзя завершить на iRO, поскольку Yggdrasilid внутри не устанавливает нужную переменную.

requirements.condition: Source advises a strong party; no required party size or universal availability is established.

reviews.detail: Pinned undated source says this quest cannot currently be completed on iRO due to a missing quest-variable update. This is retained as a source warning, not a verified current server state.

10.original_instruction: Chose if you want to go to Splendide or Manuk for your reward. Splendide: Talk to the Laphine Commander, and then Arioss. You will receive 1,500,000 Base EXP , 35,000 Job EXP , and 10 Splendide Coins. Manuk: Talk to Etol, and then with the Laphine Prisoner. You will receive 1,500,000 Base EXP , 35,000 Job EXP , and 10 Manuk Coins.

10.full_en: Chose if you want to go to Splendide or Manuk for your reward.

reviews.detail: Guardian prints spl_fld01 at the dungeon entrance; Two Tribes prints a trail on spl_fild01. Preserve both literals and mark the former unverified rather than silently correcting coordinates.
Neat Etorr and Etol, and Yggdrasiliad and Yggdrasilid, retain separate source identities; spelling similarity does not prove an alias.
Source offers choices at investigation, assistance and reward stages. No proven cross-stage forced tribe lock is stated; each choice group is local to its stage, and rewards must not be summed.
Final reward has two exclusive branches. Header EXP and OR-coins summarize one chosen branch, not a third grant.
